$comment: Biology course outline. v1 holds only the 116 sprint track (S1); the zero-to-hero core with the 國中 bridges (docs/design/02-science-map.md §4) is added at M1. Edit this JSON, never docs/curriculum/.
subject: biology
decisions: 116 sprint first: review chapters for students who studied 國中生物 and 必修生物 in school; the full zero-to-hero core (with the mandatory 國中 bridges) follows for 117.
The 課綱 spine 細胞 → 遺傳 → 演化 → 生物多樣性 is kept (verified final_units order 1–22); the 課綱 lets editors set their own chapter order, and this order matches its sub-themes.
BMb-Ⅴc-1~4 (history) and BMc-Ⅴc-1 (transgenic applications) are woven into the related chapters, as the 課綱 says, not taught as separate chapters.
Terms CEEC used beyond the stated depth (115 Q29: 發酵作用、光反應、固碳反應; 115 Q32: ATP components; DNA before BGa-Ⅴc-5) appear only as clearly labelled term-level previews.
Exam-format chapters (scoring, 混合題 writing, practice papers) are shared by the four 自然 subjects and live in inquiry.json (s116-sci-exam-skills part, s116-sci-mock capstone), not in this file.

Owner approved the 自然 sprint outline (2026-11-16): keep the 60-chapter size; write ONE subject at a time (rate limits); biology relies on the shared inquiry exam-skills part; the shared 自然 mock is the only science practice paper; environment-energy stays one chapter.
openQuestions: Exam-item links (examItems) are added per chapter in S2 from src/data/registry/exam/items/biology.json.
Reviewed concepts (reviews) are added per chapter in S2, once their glossary entries exist.

Integrator (2026-11-16): the science map has B4.5 (biodiversity) depend on the 地科 geologic-time chapter (earth/s116-earth-history) because 115 Q34 uses a 地質年代表. The verified research does not support that edge: unit 22's depends_on is unit 21 plus 國中 Gc-Ⅳ-2 / Gb-Ⅳ-1, and the correction classifies 115 Q34 as a 生物科試題, not a crossover 題組. So no cross-subject prereq is added; the table is read in context. Owner to confirm or update the science map.

Mendelian ratios use 國中 ratios and basic probability, but the research marks that bridge 'unverified' (no 數學 code checked), so no math prereq is added. Decide whether s116-mendel should list math/s116-probability.

國中 biology (body systems, plant structure, ecology: Db/Dc/L codes) can appear in 學測 as background knowledge (考試說明 p.4; samples cite Db-Ⅳ-7 and Lb-Ⅳ-2), but no 高中必修 code covers it. Decide whether the sprint needs a short 國中 essentials chapter.

question.zh-tw: 生命最小的單位裡，裝了些什麼？
question.en: What is inside the smallest unit of life?

parts.whyHere: First 必修 sub-theme (細胞的構造與功能 BDa-Ⅴc-1~9). Verified order: BMb-Ⅴc-1 cell theory first (units 1–3, taught together with cell structure per 說明 1-2), ATP after organelles (unit 4 depends on unit 3), energy conversion (unit 5), then cell cycle → mitosis → meiosis → differentiation (units 6–9). Correction: DNA in units 6 and 8 is only a flagged preview.

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過國中生物與高中必修生物、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied junior-high and required senior-high biology in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.zh-tw: 細胞學說與細胞的構造

blurb.zh-tw: 細胞學說怎麼形成、不同細胞的形態與功能，以及原核與真核細胞的構造。
blurb.en: How the cell theory formed, how cell shape fits function, and the structures of prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明細胞學說的形成是一段科學過程
objectives.en: Explain how the cell theory formed through a scientific process

objectives.zh-tw: 比較不同細胞的形態、構造與功能，並選擇合適的玻片製作方法
objectives.en: Compare cell shapes, structures and functions, and choose a suitable slide-making method

objectives.zh-tw: 比較原核細胞與真核細胞，說出主要胞器的功能
objectives.en: Compare prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells and state what the main organelles do

chapters.activity: Sprint review: cell-theory history (Hooke, Leeuwenhoek, Brown, Schleiden, Virchow; 115 Q30; 113 Q3 why viruses are not yet classified), the four slide methods (112 Q13 options describe actions, not names), micrometer use with no scale-conversion arithmetic, organelles 內質網/高基氏體/液泡/核糖體/粒線體/葉綠體.

title.zh-tw: ATP 與光合、呼吸作用的能量轉換
title.en: ATP and energy conversion in photosynthesis and respiration

blurb.zh-tw: ATP 是細胞活動的直接能量來源；光合作用與呼吸作用如何轉換能量。
blurb.en: ATP as the direct energy source for cell activities, and how photosynthesis and respiration convert energy.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明 ATP 是細胞生理作用所需能量的直接來源
objectives.en: Explain that ATP is the direct energy source for cell activities

objectives.zh-tw: 說明光合作用與呼吸作用之間的能量轉換關係，並從圖表分辨兩者
objectives.en: Explain the energy relationship between photosynthesis and respiration, and tell them apart in a figure

chapters.activity: Sprint review: energy relationship only, no mechanisms (說明 4-2) and no ATP structural formula (3-1); labelled term previews for 發酵作用/光反應/固碳反應 (115 Q29) and ATP components (115 Q32); figure reading as in 114 Q2.

title.zh-tw: 細胞週期、有絲分裂與減數分裂
title.en: The cell cycle, mitosis and meiosis

blurb.zh-tw: 間期與分裂期、兩種核分裂、配子的形成，以及受精卵如何發育成不同的細胞。
blurb.en: Interphase and division, the two kinds of nuclear division, gamete formation, and how a zygote gives rise to many cell types.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明細胞週期由間期與細胞分裂期組成，以及染色體在分裂前複製
objectives.en: Describe the cell cycle as interphase plus division, with chromosomes copied before division

objectives.zh-tw: 比較有絲分裂與減數分裂，並用單套、雙套（n、2n）描述配子的形成
objectives.en: Compare mitosis and meiosis, and describe gamete formation with haploid and diploid (n, 2n)

objectives.zh-tw: 說明受精卵經有絲分裂與細胞分化形成不同類型的細胞
objectives.en: Explain how a zygote forms many cell types through mitosis and differentiation

chapters.activity: Sprint review: interphase and division not subdivided (5-1); mitosis phases not named (7-2); DNA only as a labelled preview (taught in s116-molecular-genetics); onion root tip (115 Q28); two division types (114 Q1); why DNA is copied before meiosis (CEEC 112 suggestion); differentiation introductory only (9-1).

question.zh-tw: 孩子為什麼像爸媽，又不完全一樣？
question.en: Why do children resemble their parents, but not exactly?

parts.whyHere: Second 必修 sub-theme (BGa-Ⅴc-1~7, with BMb-Ⅴc-2~3 and BMc-Ⅴc-1 woven in). Verified order: Mendel (unit 10, depends on unit 8 meiosis) → extensions (11) → chromosome theory and sex chromosomes (12, depends on units 8 and 10) → sex-linked inheritance (13, depends on 11 and 12) → nucleic acids (14) → central dogma (15) → variation and environment (16) → transgenic applications (17, depends on 15).

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過國中生物與高中必修生物、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied junior-high and required senior-high biology in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

title.zh-tw: 孟德爾遺傳法則及其延伸

blurb.zh-tw: 孟德爾如何從實驗推論遺傳規律，以及共顯性、複等位基因與多基因遺傳。
blurb.en: How Mendel reasoned from experiments to the laws of heredity, plus codominance, multiple alleles and polygenic inheritance.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明孟德爾如何設計實驗並推論出分離律與獨立分配律
objectives.en: Explain how Mendel designed his experiments and inferred the laws of segregation and independent assortment

objectives.zh-tw: 用遺傳法則推算子代的基因型與表現型比例
objectives.en: Use the laws to work out offspring genotype and phenotype ratios

objectives.zh-tw: 以 ABO 血型說明共顯性與複等位基因，並認識多基因遺傳
objectives.en: Explain codominance and multiple alleles with ABO blood types, and recognise polygenic inheritance

chapters.activity: Sprint review: 遺傳因子 as an abstract term inferred from traits; Mendel's reasoning (BMb 2-1~2-3; the laws are new in 必修, 國中 excluded them); ABO pedigrees (114 Q4, 115 Q31); polygenic skin colour with no calculation (說明 2-2).

title.zh-tw: 遺傳的染色體學說與性聯遺傳
title.en: The chromosome theory and sex-linked inheritance

blurb.zh-tw: 遺傳因子位在染色體上、性染色體的發現，以及紅綠色盲的性聯遺傳與系譜判讀。
blurb.en: Hereditary factors on chromosomes, the discovery of sex chromosomes, and red-green colour blindness with pedigree reading.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明科學家如何把遺傳現象與染色體連結起來
objectives.en: Explain how scientists linked hereditary phenomena to chromosomes

objectives.zh-tw: 以紅綠色盲為例，用 X 染色體記號推算性聯遺傳
objectives.en: Work out sex-linked inheritance with X-chromosome notation, using red-green colour blindness

objectives.zh-tw: 從系譜判斷一個性狀是否可能為性聯遺傳
objectives.en: Decide from a pedigree whether a trait could be sex-linked

chapters.activity: Sprint review: factors become physical entities on chromosomes (3-1, 3-2); history of sex-chromosome discovery (BMb 3-1); XAXa/XaY notation and carrier mothers (考試說明 sample 1); a written reason that rules out sex-linkage (112 Q50).

title.zh-tw: 核酸、中心法則與基因轉殖
title.en: Nucleic acids, the central dogma and transgenic technology

blurb.zh-tw: 遺傳物質是核酸、DNA 到蛋白質的中心法則、性狀表徵與環境，以及基因轉殖的應用。
blurb.en: Nucleic acids as the genetic material, the central dogma from DNA to protein, traits and environment, and uses of transgenic technology.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明遺傳物質為核酸，並說出 DNA 粗萃取各步驟的作用
objectives.en: Explain that the genetic material is nucleic acid, and the purpose of each step of crude DNA extraction

objectives.zh-tw: 以中心法則概述複製、轉錄與轉譯及其發生位置
objectives.en: Outline replication, transcription and translation with the central dogma, and where they happen

objectives.zh-tw: 說明遺傳變異與環境如何影響性狀表徵，並舉出基因轉殖的應用
objectives.en: Explain how genetic variation and environment shape a trait, and give applications of transgenic technology

chapters.activity: Sprint review: no DNA structural formula (5-2); kiwi DNA extraction steps, no chicken blood (115 Q33); two kinds of nucleic acid (114 Q5); central dogma with no mechanism, no enzyme except 聚合酶, no gene regulation (6-2, 6-3), regulation only as given data (115 Q37–39); transgenic uses with no mechanism (BMc 1-2; 111 Q23, 115 Q40–43).

question.zh-tw: 今天這麼多種生物，是怎麼來的？
question.en: Where did today's variety of living things come from?

parts.whyHere: Third 必修 sub-theme (BGb-Ⅴc-1~5, with BMb-Ⅴc-4 woven in), ending with biodiversity, which closes 必修生物. Verified order: trait frequencies change (unit 18, depends on unit 16) → Darwin and natural selection (19; correction: also depends on unit 16, heritable variation) → common ancestry and classification (20) → evolutionary evidence and classification (21, depends on units 3 and 14) → biodiversity (22).

note.zh-tw: 給已在學校讀過國中生物與高中必修生物、準備考 116 學測的同學：重點複習，不是從零開始。完整的從零課程將在 117 學年度課程中推出。
note.en: For students who studied junior-high and required senior-high biology in school and sit the 116 GSAT: a focused review, not zero-to-hero. The full lessons arrive in the 117 course.

blurb.zh-tw: 性狀的表徵比例為何會變動、演化觀念的發展，以及達爾文的天擇說。
blurb.en: Why trait frequencies change, how evolutionary ideas developed, and Darwin's theory of natural selection.

objectives.zh-tw: 以樺尺蛾等實例說明族群中性狀的表徵比例會隨環境與時間變動
objectives.en: Use cases such as the peppered moth to explain how trait frequencies shift with environment and time

objectives.zh-tw: 說明演化觀念的發展，以及共同祖先、天擇與演化理論的關係
objectives.en: Describe how evolutionary ideas developed and how common ancestry and natural selection relate to the theory

objectives.zh-tw: 用天擇寫出評分原則接受的解釋，並區分天擇與人擇
objectives.en: Write an explanation by natural selection that the marking guide accepts, and tell natural from artificial selection

chapters.activity: Sprint review: peppered moth (說明 1-1) and Micrococcus in nylon wastewater (113 Q7); history of evolutionary ideas (BMb 4-1); 112 Q57 rubric (full credit for 天擇, partial for only 突變 or only 適者生存, none for 慢慢適應); broiler chickens and 人擇 (113 Q37–39).

title.zh-tw: 分類系統的演變與生物多樣性

blurb.zh-tw: 共同祖先與演化證據如何改變分類系統、從五界到三域，以及生物多樣性的形成。
blurb.en: How common ancestry and evolutionary evidence reshaped classification, from five kingdoms to three domains, and how biodiversity arose.

objectives.zh-tw: 說明共同祖先的概念如何改變林奈以來的分類系統
objectives.en: Explain how the idea of common ancestry changed classification since Linnaeus

objectives.zh-tw: 以同源與同功構造等演化證據判讀親緣關係樹，並說明五界到三域的改變
objectives.en: Read a phylogenetic tree using evidence such as homologous and analogous structures, and explain the move from five kingdoms to three domains

objectives.zh-tw: 說明物種不斷形成與滅絕，造就今日的生物多樣性
objectives.en: Explain how species keep arising and going extinct, producing today's biodiversity

chapters.activity: Sprint review: Linnaeus had no idea of kinship (3-1) and binomial naming in context (115 Q35); birds and reptiles, homologous vs analogous (考試說明 sample 2); tree reading (111 Q46–48, 115 Q36); where viruses fit (4-4); biodiversity with a 地質年代表 as in 115 Q34 (a biology item).
